mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (both INDPRO and HOUST below 95% of their 12-month moving average) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL below 2.0% year-over-year), a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS within 0.1% of its current level) supports sustained equity market gains, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% YoY), the S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential investment (RSAFS) indicates strong housing market activity and consumer confidence, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500,000 units annually, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9.5%) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a recessionary environment with accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate earnings declines.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 9.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, the S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO below 95% of its 12-month moving average), a decline in industrial production signals reduced corporate output and potential earnings pressure, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO < 95% of 12-month MA), the S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
